How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Professional Cleaning Service?

December 28, 2021
Table of Contents

Hiring a cleaning service can be a real lifesaver, but you do need to consider cleaning service prices. When you find out that the cost of a cleaning servicecan be as low as $100 for the average home, you probably realize that getting a sparkling clean house is extremely affordable.

There are variations in the average cleaning service cost, and it is a good idea to learn more about what you can expect from house cleaning ratesso there are no surprises. You need to know so that you don’t end up with surprise charges for cleaning services.

To help you understand more about maid service costswe have created this guide to the costs of cleaning services. Our guide is more than a house cleaning price list, we will explain to you what different services entail with their house cleaning prices.

How much does a cleaning service cost?

If you hire an independent house cleaner, they normally charge between $22 and $53 per hour. This sort of a house cleaning service may not provide their own cleaning tools, but they will do a great job if you instruct them well.

For a licensed, bonded, and insured cleaning company, you can expect to pay $30 to $60 per hour per cleaner. Working with a professional cleaning service gives you the peace of mind that they will use the best cleaning supplies and tools with skill.

You should not always choose the cheapest cleaning service, but just because a cleaning service is cheap does not mean they don’t clean well. It is a good idea to call around and see what sort of offer you can find with different cleaning service and find one you can trust.

Cleaning Service Cost By Day

The average home in the USA pays about $150 for a full cleaning. This comes from a normal range of prices from $100 up to $300. You can somewhat reliably estimate your cleaning service price by the size of your house, where a small house would be in the $100 area, while a large house would cost $300.

Some cleaning services will need to inspect your house to do an estimate. These companies usually do a great job of cleaning because they estimate the right amount of work for them to make your home as clean as can be.

When you talk with a cleaning service on the phone they may ask you for the square footage of your home to make an estimate. This is a good way to get a relative price, but they still may need to make adjustments when they see the condition of your home.

Different Types Of Cleanings

There are several different styles of house cleaning services. They can do different levels of cleaning based on what your home requires.

A deep cleaning service will remove any dust from all the corners of your home. A cleaning company may require you to buy a deep cleaning service on their first visit because they don’t know the condition of your house and want to make it extra clean.

A standard cleaning can be performed once a home has gotten down to a baseline state of cleaning. A standard cleaning is what you will be charged for a recurring cleaning service.

A deep cleaning service costs about $50 more than a standard cleaning service. Deep cleaning uses more effort and more cleaning products to make your home as clean as possible.

Maid Service Cost

A maid is a little bit more than a regular house cleaner. They can also help around the house with things like cooking, laundry and childcare.

You can hire a live-in maid, who will be in service to you a set number of hours per day to help in whatever way you need. This service costs $25,000 to $50,000 per year as a salary.

There are also part time maids who can do the same chores, but are not with you a full 40 hours per week. For a part time maid you can pay from $1,500 per month to $3,700 per month.

Per Room Pricing

Some cleaning services can have a per room rate. These services might add fees to their per room price depending on what it takes to clean it.

It can be difficult to know what a per room cleaning service will end up costing because they don’t know how much work each of your rooms will take. It is often a technique to get you signed up and then they add more fees when they see what your home is like.

Recurring Cleaning Services

When you become a regular customer of a cleaning service they will normally give you a reduced fee. For some companies, this might be up to 20% savings from the price of a deep cleaning.

When house cleaners come to your house on a regular basis, they know that they can expect your house to be in a certain state of cleanliness. They will not have to work as much per visit because your home will stay cleaner than a house that does not have a regular cleaning service.

It is nice to build a relationship with a cleaning service that you trust. It makes your life easier when you never have to worry about if your house is going to get cleaned or who can help you when you need it.

Special Rates For Cleaning

If you have special requests or certain situations, a cleaning service may charge more. One of the possible charges is a fee for cleaning up a home with pets.

There tends to be a lot more work cleaning up pet hair than in a non-pet owning home, so cleaners need to be compensated for the extra work. The fee could be a flat rate or an hourly charge, but you will end up paying about $20 more if you have pets.

If you want to have a cleaning service come to clean up a party, there could be a special rate as well. A party clean up service usually costs $50 more than a deep cleaning service.
